name: The Torghuts' return from the Volga
traveler: Ubashi Khan and the Torghut Kalmyks
summary: Squeezed by Russian rule on the Volga, where their Oirat ancestors had settled in the 1630s, some 170,000 Torghuts set out in midwinter for Dzungaria, their old homeland, now under the Qing. Harried by Russian troops and Kazakh raiders across thousands of kilometres of steppe, barely half reach the Ili in July.

stops.note: They leave their pastures east of the Volga.
Across the Yaik (Ural) on the ice.
Through the Kazakh steppe, under attack.
Starving, they follow the lake's shore.
Barely half arrive, and the Qing settle them in Dzungaria.
